what: Whole-frame video to video on one clip, 2026-10-09: every render, its settings, its wall time and one timing measure.
source: Video/mryo/v2p/v2p_00001.mp4 on the output share: 906 frames, 1344x768, 24 fps, the finished one-person render of 2026-10-08, so the lead is already the person wanted.

common.models: ref2va checkpoint, Qwen3-VL encoder, video VAE, the int8 builds named by h3_config.MODELS
common.node: MiniMaxH3AudioFreezeSong with a MiniMaxH3MaskedSource whose mask is all ones, motion_reference whole frame; one window a run, continued by continue_from
common.seeds: 730451892 plus the window's index, except where a note says another seed
common.outputs: Video/mrship/<name>_00001.mp4 on the output share; each has a PNG beside it that holds its graph and text

measure: lag: for each offset within 12 frames, the mean correlation of the render's frame-to-frame change map with the input's, over frames where the input moves; the offset with the highest mean is reported with that mean. Negative means the render is ahead. Whole frame, then the centre half. A continued window is measured on the frames it wrote. Low correlations (many small figures, a changed look) make the offset unreliable.
